name: NYC Votes Youth Ambassador Program
what_you_do: A youth-led program for teens who want to get other young people to vote. You join weekly meetings, take summer trips to learn about city issues, host voter events and help create content and a research project.
who_can_apply: New Yorkers ages 14 to 18. The program page does not list other rules.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the pages read. Ask the program.
duration: Weekly meetings, with weekly summer trips. The full length of the program is not stated.
deadline_text: The Youth page says applications for 2026 are now closed. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Check the NYC Votes Youth Ambassadors page for the next call for applications.
notes: Run by the City of New York Campaign Finance Board. Past ambassadors registered voters at public events and with other city agencies. The pages do not say whether the work is paid or needs a work permit.
